2 حرّب , inf. n. تَحْرِيبٌ, He sharpened a spearhead. (S, K.) ―
-b2- (tropical:) He angered: (S, A:) or angered violently: (K:) and he provoked, or exasperated. (S, K, TA.) And it is said to signify (assumed tropical:) He acquainted a person with a thing that angered him: but where it is said to have this meaning, it is accord. to one reading with ج and hemzeh [in the places of ح and ب]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
